Basis for Intervening:
The Texas Industrial Energy Consumers (TIEC) is an unincorporated trade association of industrial consumers of electricity. TIEC’s members own and operate industrial facilities in the MISO service territory and purchase substantial amounts of electricity from companies within the MISO service territory. Some of TIEC’s members currently self-generate electricity, some portion of which is or may be sold at wholesale and transmitted over MISO’s service territory. TIEC’s members also purchase significant amounts of electricity at retail rates from Entergy Texas, Inc. (ETI), who is a transmission owning member of MISO. MISO’s application in this proceeding raises a number of issues of significant interest that will directly impact TIEC members as customers of MISO. Therefore, TIEC has a direct, substantial and vital interest in the outcome of this proceeding.
